import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_25/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_25/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join on 'State' as per operation history
df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="State", how="inner", suffixes=('_x', '_y'))

# Ensure columns have the correct types and names as per target schema:
# Target Schema: 
# ['State': string, 'Participation_x': string, 'English': float, 'Math_x': float, 'Reading': float, 'Science': float, 'Composite': float, 
#  'Participation_y': string, 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing': integer, 'Math_y': integer, 'Total': integer]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
df['State'] = df['State'].astype(str)
df['Participation_x'] = df['Participation_x'].astype(str)
df['English'] = df['English'].astype(float)
df['Math_x'] = df['Math_x'].astype(float)
df['Reading'] = df['Reading'].astype(float)
df['Science'] = df['Science'].astype(float)
df['Composite'] = df['Composite'].astype(float)
df['Participation_y'] = df['Participation_y'].astype(str)
df['Evidence-Based Reading and Writing'] = df['Evidence-Based Reading and Writing'].astype(int)
df['Math_y'] = df['Math_y'].astype(int)
df['Total'] = df['Total'].astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['State', 'Participation_x', 'English', 'Math_x', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite',
                  'Participation_y', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math_y', 'Total']

Target1_25 = df[target_columns]

# Write the final target table to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_25/target_multisource.csv"
Target1_25.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_25/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_25/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Rename columns in df0 and df1 to match target schema exactly (no suffixes)
# The target schema has Participation_x and Participation_y, Math_x and Math_y, so rename accordingly
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    "Participation": "Participation_x",
    "Math": "Math_x"
})

df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    "Participation": "Participation_y",
    "Math": "Math_y"
})

# Join on 'State' column (inner join)
df_joined = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on="State", how="inner")

# Group by the leftmost non-float columns that are unique and appear in target schema:
# According to target schema and examples, group by ['State', 'Participation_x']
# Aggregate other columns by max (to preserve values, since no aggregation function specified)
agg_dict = {
    "English": "max",
    "Math_x": "max",
    "Reading": "max",
    "Science": "max",
    "Composite": "max",
    "Participation_y": "max",
    "Evidence-Based Reading and Writing": "max",
    "Math_y": "max",
    "Total": "max"
}

df_grouped = df_joined.groupby(["State", "Participation_x"], as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['State', 'Participation_x', 'English', 'Math_x', 'Reading', 'Science', 'Composite',
                  'Participation_y', 'Evidence-Based Reading and Writing', 'Math_y', 'Total']

df_final = df_grouped[target_columns]

# Write to output CSV
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_25/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
